_doc: Two-axis reconciliation for clinical-research OOUX objects — enforced by tools/lint_layering.py. See docs/ooux-layer-blindness.md. AXIS 1 KIND (Jessica Talisman): is this a class (an object / the TBox, which is small) or a property/relation/context (the ABox, where the data lives)? A property reified as a class is demoted, not tiered. AXIS 2 TIER (only for kind=class): which layer owns it — dedupe/subclass (resolved) vs promote/review (backlog). dedupe/subclass PASS; kind!=class, promote, and review WARN (tracked) until --strict. An object absent from this map is an untriaged shadow/orphan and FAILS the gate — that is what prevents recurrence.

_kinds.class: an object / a TBox class — proceed to the TIER axis
_kinds.property: an attribute or a literal value (firstName, date, a metric) — model as a property with a domain, not a class
_kinds.relation: a relationship, role, or CONTEXT (Jessica Talisman: 'context is a property, not an object') — model as an object property, not a class

_verdicts.dedupe: same concept the parent already owns — bind the view/target to it, do not re-mint
_verdicts.subclass: domain-native specialization — mint in cr:, but rdfs:subClassOf the named parent
_verdicts.promote: cross-domain primitive; no parent exists yet — candidate for Core or a mid-layer (RFC)
_verdicts.review: home tier not yet decided — tracked so the map stays complete; resolve before federation
_verdicts.demote: not a class at all — a property/relation/context reified as an object (KIND axis); re-model as a property

Date.note: a datetime value, not an object — model as a property (a milestone-date is a property of the milestone/subject)

Tag.note: an annotation/classification value — a property or skos:Concept, not an object

Budget.note: cross-industry finance primitive — candidate finance mid-layer (RFC)

DataQualityMetric.note: measurement/quality primitive — candidate Core Evidence leaf or mid-layer (RFC)

AnalysisRequest.note: cr ontology class, no parent chain — assign tier

AnalysisService.note: cr ontology class, no parent chain — software service tier

Participant.note: SENSITIVE — the pseudonymous subject/boundary; route via hcls:Person + Enrollment bridge, do not merge

PersonRole.note: a role is a relationship/context, not an object — see ADR-0020/0022 (agency is a role); context is a property, not an object

Protocol.note: document + plan; vs top:Document and USDM

TherapeuticArea.note: a classification value (skos:Concept), not an object

UserRole.note: a role is a relationship/context, not an object — see ADR-0020/0022
